name: Camo Local GC Sunday Bag #2
desc: Built by hand over time, the bag pictured is the exact item you are purchasing. It is a true one-of-one offering from a single maker. Constructed from heavyweight 18oz camo poly-cotton canvas and paired with waxed brown leather accents, this piece balances durability with refinement. The core hardware is solid brass, while brass-plated Chicago screws provide a consistent finish throughout. The main bag tube is lined with our signature black sailcloth, adding strength and structure while keeping overall weight to a minimum. YKK waterproof zips secure both compartments, with our Times of Leisure bird embroidery featured in the main pocket and a Local GC monogram embroidered on the side. The opening is formed around a 200mm (8-inch) stainless steel hoop, paired with a leather divider to help maintain shape and provide easy access to your clubs. Due to the heavier canvas used on this build, we have omitted the external water bottle sleeve found on some previous bags. However, the main side pocket is large enough to fit a water bottle when required. A fibreglass rod spine runs through the body of the bag, adding structure without unnecessary weight. A leather handhold has been incorporated into the base for comfortable lifting and repositioning. The shoulder strap features open-cell foam wrapped in sand pig suede and canvas, finished with leather reinforcement for comfort and durability. The main carry strap is crafted from 3.5mm fine-grain vegetable-tanned buffalo leather belting. The bag weighs 1.77kg (3.9lbs). Key Features Handmade from durable 18oz poly-cotton camo canvas Waxed brown leather accents Solid brass core hardware Brass-plated Chicago screws Black sailcloth-lined main bag tube YKK waterproof zips on both compartments 200mm (8-inch) opening with stainless steel hoop Leather divider Fibreglass rod spine for lightweight structure Leather base handhold 3.5mm fine-grain vegetable-tanned buffalo leather carry strap Weight: 1.77kg (3.9lbs) Every Sunday Bag will be made and released individually. They won't arrive in runs or batches, and each one will be slightly different from the last. The bag pictured is the exact bag you will receive. Each piece is crafted slowly and built by hand. An uncommon expression of Local GC craft, created for those who value honest production and the story behind what they carry. Shipping Free shipping within New Zealand Australia: NZD $150 shipping due to size Available to New Zealand and Australian buyers only If you are located outside these regions, please get in touch before release and we can arrange a shipping quote and add an option for your location. Please Note This is a Sunday-style carry bag. While the bag appears free-standing in some photos due to the internal fibreglass spine, additional weight has been placed inside to help stabilise it for photography. With clubs installed, the bag will not free-stand and should not be considered a stand bag. We also aim to minimise our environmental impact. Each bag is shipped in a recycled golf bag box. While we'd love to send every order in a Local GC-branded carton, there are countless perfectly usable golf bag boxes heading to landfill every day. We'd rather give them a second life.

name: Daybreak Local GC Sunday Bag
desc: Handmade Sunday Bag — Limited Piece This is a one-off. Made entirely by hand in New Zealand, from first cut to final stitch, this Sunday bag isn’t part of a run — it’s a standalone piece. The bag shown here is the exact one available. Designed for golfers who value craftsmanship over mass production, this is built to age, not wear out. Cut from 14.9oz poly-cotton canvas and paired with black cow leather, the structure is intentional. It starts firm and holds its shape, then gradually softens with use — developing creases, character, and wear patterns unique to how you carry and play. Much like raw denim, no two end up the same. The dancing swallow embroidery runs across the body and pocket — subtle at a glance, but a defining detail up close. It’s not branding. It’s part of the piece. Every component is chosen for longevity and feel. Solid brass hardware throughout, secured with brass-plated Chicago screws. A YKK waterproof zip protects the main compartment, lined internally with black sailcloth for added durability without excess weight. A stainless steel 200mm (8-inch) hoop keeps the opening clean and accessible, supported by a leather divider. Internally, a fiberglass spine maintains structure while keeping the carry light. Function is kept considered and minimal: – Integrated water bottle sleeve for quick access – Reinforced canvas base handle for easy lift and reposition – Local GC monogram stitched internally The carry strap is built for walking rounds — open-cell foam padding wrapped in canvas, finished with a pig suede overlay. It’s anchored with a 3.5mm vegetable-tanned buffalo leather belt, selected for strength and the way it wears over time. This isn’t a mass-produced bag. It’s a piece that will break in, mark up, and become your own over time. One of One. Weight: 1.7kg (3.75 lbs) Key Features One-of-one, fully handmade construction 14.9oz poly-cotton canvas body Black cow leather detailing to the bag Sand pig suede strap detail Dancing swallow embroidery on body and pocket Brass hardware Black sailcloth-lined interior tube YKK waterproof zip closure Integrated water bottle holder 200mm / 8-inch opening Leather divider Fiberglass spine for lightweight structure Reinforced canvas base grab loop 3.5mm veg-tanned buffalo leather strap Each bag is built individually, without batch production. The focus is on pace, material, and finish—resulting in a piece that will continue to change and improve with use. Shipping Free within New Zealand Australia: $150 (oversized item) NZ & AU only — get in touch for international enquiries Note This is a Sunday-style carry bag. While the internal spine gives structure, it is not designed to stand on its own when loaded. Any upright photos have been staged for display with weights in the base off the bag. To reduce environmental impact, all bags are shipped in recycled golf bag boxes. Reusing existing packaging helps divert quality materials from landfill and aligns with our approach to considered, responsible production.
